object_description: narrow rectangular volume with a continuous angled longitudinal roof
design_condition: The volume is placed along the motorway to separate infrastructure from a generous landscape area, while its eastern connection organizes visitor access and service traffic.

positive.statement: The positioning divides the situation into two differentiated landscape areas.
The self-contained volume appears reservedly quiet despite its large dimensions.
The structural and foundation requirements are used architecturally to develop a specific spatial typology.
The internal organization consistently follows the logic established by the volume’s positioning.
The operational processes are well recorded and atmospherically woven into the field-like spatial concept.
The skylights and two-story rooms create differentiated spatial qualities within the rigid structure.
The project proposal consistently works through all subject areas and translates the task into convincing architecture.
The type mediates between commercial-building requirements and a clearly recognizable architectural character.
